newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Rate on Cyprus 91 day t-bills at 5.62 percent.
newsitem.headline: Rate on Cyprus 91 day t-bills at 5.62 percent.

text.p: The central bank on Wednesday sold 15.0 million pounds ($29.5 million) worth of 91-day treasury bills with a coupon of 5.62 percent from 5.65 percent at the last auction held on February 26.
A central bank statement said it had offered up to 15 million pounds in bills. It received bids totalling 28.6 million pounds.
Treasury bill auctions are held twice a month. ($=0.51 pounds) -- Nicosia newsroom 357 2 365089
